title: Game runtime generation
description: B1: the effective configuration the control plane hands one game runtime, as generation.json in that runtime's own volume, beside the secrets.json of the same generation. The runtime validates both, refuses a contract version it does not know, and keeps running its last good generation. Any change to this document other than its generation number, or to its secrets, costs the world a game-server restart; a newer generation equal in everything but its number is adopted without one.

generation.description: The generation number. A higher number replaces a lower one.

port.description: The first of the world's three UDP ports.

status_interval_s.description: How often the plugin rewrites the runtime's world status file, in seconds.

status_url.description: Where the runtime reports its status to the control plane. Absent, the runtime only logs it.
